'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Western Russia attacks]]
****Three people are killed by explosions at residential buildings in [[Belgorod]], [[Russia]], near the border with [[Ukraine]]. Fifty buildings are partially destroyed by the explosions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62025541 (BBC News)]
***Armed forces of Russia and the [[separatist]] [[Luhansk People's Republic]] capture the entire [[Luhansk Oblast]] after [[Battle of Lysychansk|seizing]] [[Lysychansk]]. Ukrainian forces confirm that they were forced to retreat. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/07/03/europe/russia-ukraine-luhansk-lysychansk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***Six people are killed and many others are injured as heavy [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] from [[rocket launcher]]s hit the city of [[Sloviansk]], in [[Donetsk Oblast]], according to a report from the city's mayor. [https://news.yahoo.com/shelling-hits-eastern-ukrainian-city-122029627.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[2022 Karakalpak protests]]
**Five people are killed and thousands are injured after mass protests in [[Nukus]], [[Karakalpakstan]], [[Uzbekistan]]. [[President of Uzbekistan]] [[Shavkat Mirziyoyev]] accuses "rioters" of violence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/uzbekistans-president-says-there-are-casualties-protests-russian-agencies-2022-07-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/3/uzbekistan-president-announces-fatalities-in-karakalpakstan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Marmolada serac collapse]]
**Seven people are killed, eight are injured, and 13 others are reported missing after a [[serac]] collapses in [[Marmolada]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62029780 (BBC News)]
*Twenty people are killed and 13 others are injured when a [[bus plunge]]s into a deep [[ravine]] in [[Sherani District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bus-crash-kills-20-southwest-pakistan-official-2022-07-03/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed in a [[shark attack]] off the coast of [[Sahl Hasheesh]], [[Egypt]], on the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/836901/egypt-shuts-down-red-sea-beaches-after-tourist-killed-in-shark-attack/story/ (GMA News Online)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nauru]]
***[[Nauru]] reports its first death from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/470265/covid-19-nauru-records-first-death-niue-records-10-community-cases (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Copenhagen mall shooting]]
**Three people are killed and four more are injured during a [[mass shooting]] at the [[Field's|Field's shopping centre]] in [[Amager]], [[Copenhagen]], [[Denmark]]. A suspect has been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62030919 (BBC News)]
*Fifty-one people are arrested by the [[Sri Lankan Navy]] while trying to [[emigrate]] to [[Australia]] by sea. Police said that [[undocumented immigration]] has increased because of [[Sri Lanka]]'s [[2019-present Sri Lankan economic crisis|economic crisis]]. [https://www.outlookindia.com/international/sri-lankan-navy-nabs-51-people-illegally-migrating-to-australia-to-escape-economic-crisis-official-news-206446 (''Outlook'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Formula One World Championship]]
**[[2022 British Grand Prix]]
***[[Formula One drivers from Spain|Spanish racing driver]] [[Carlos Sainz Jr.]] of [[Scuderia Ferrari]] wins the first [[Formula One]] race of his career. [https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/article263141433.html (''Miami Herald'')]
*[[Candidates Tournament 2022]]
**[[Ian Nepomniachtchi]] wins the tournament with only one round remaining and qualifies for the [[World Chess Championship 2023]] against current World Chess Champion [[Magnus Carlsen]]. [https://www.chess.com/news/view/2022-fide-candidates-tournament-round-13 (chess.com)]
